**Download `Sims3DS-<version>.zip` below** (under *Assets*) and follow the 4 steps in the [README](https://github.com/Ryan3DSMods/Sims3DS#install-in-4-steps).

- For the **New 3DS, New 3DS XL and New 2DS XL** (custom firmware needed). Not for the original 3DS / 2DS.
- **No game files are included.** The `extractor` in the zip copies them from **your own** The Sims Complete Collection.
- Close the game with **START → Quit**: pressing HOME while playing can crash the HOME Menu (being investigated).

The 3D HOME Menu logo is made from "Sims game logo 3D" by [3DTwinkie](https://www.printables.com/@3DTwinkie) (CC BY-SA 4.0).
Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Electronic Arts or Maxis.
